title.en: MALAC AÑANG RESIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES EXECUTIVE CRDER NO. 224 PROVIDING THAT THE VARIOUS ADMINISTRATIVE ACTIONS REQUIRED BY 'EXBOUTIVE ORDER NO. 209 DATED OCTOBUR 19, 1956, AND REORGANIZATION PLAN NC. 60 RELATIVI TO PÜBLIC UTILITIES REGULATION AND LAND TRANSPORTATION SHALL BE TAKEN ON OR BEFORE JANUARY 15, 1957.
